title: Nourishing Ethiopian Berbere Stew Hot Pot
description: A weeknight Ethiopian stew with a bitter and crispy texture, made with beer and featuring a flavorful berbere spice blend. Serve with injera or rice for a filling meal.

ingredients.name: Beer
ingredients.notes: Use a dark beer for more flavor

instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large hot pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they're translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the red bell pepper, carrots, and zucchini, and cook until the vegetables are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice blend and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the red wine and beer, stirring to deglaze the pot.
Add the tomato paste and stir to combine.
Add the vegetable broth and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, until the stew has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
